title: Demonic Overlord Emerging
description: A massive purple demonic creature with blue hair, horns, and bat-like wings bursts upward from a shattered stone floor, wielding a glowing red demonic sword. Smaller demonic figures and broken chains swirl around the glowing red portal at its feet, set against a ruined stone fortress under dramatic light rays.
prompt: A towering muscular purple demon with blue mohawk hair, curved horns, bat wings, and glowing red eyes emerges violently from a shattered stone floor, wielding a massive glowing red demonic sword with chains. Smaller demonic figures and broken chains swirl around a fiery red portal at its feet, set against ancient ruined stone architecture under dramatic god rays from a dark sky.
